Mexican Style Beans + Paneer Recipe
vegetarian | meal prep friendly | high protein

if you have any questions about the recipe or how to execute it, leave a comment and i will respond accordingly :) 

Nutrition: 
C: 43 | F: 10 | P: 25
Calories: 323 per serving 
Serves 3 or 4 depending on your hunger 

Ingredients:
120 grams Kidney Beans (Rajma), Soaked over night and pressure cooked for 30 minutes
1 tsp oil / ghee
1 onion, finely chopped
2-4 cloves garlic, minced, i was lazy so used 1 tbsp ginger garlic paste
200 grams mushrooms, sliced
one green capsicum, small cubes
150 grams paneer, small cubes / tofu can be used to make it vegan / shredded chicken for better protein macros 
Powders:
1 tsp coriander powder + 1tsp red chilli powder + 1 tsp cumin powder (jeera pwd) +1 tbsp Cajun seasoning, soooo good and a MUST imo 
1/2 tsp salt or as per your taste preference+ 1 packet oregano +1 packet chilli flakes 
1/4 cup aqua 
coriander leaves for garnish 

Method: 
-ensure you soak your kidney beans over night before making this recipe. 
-the next day, take your soaked kidney beans and pressure cook them with 1 cup pf water and a little salt for atleast 30 minutes. i prefer mushier means than ones with a slight bite and they cause me major acidity if they arent cooked properly
-add oil or ghee to a pan and add in your onion and garlic -> cook till translucent 
-add in your mushroom and allow that 2-3 minutes to cook then follow up by adding in all your powders + the aqua and stir together
add in your capsicum and cooked beans and saute then add in the paneer and cook together for 2 -3 minutes
-top with coriander leaves and enjoy :) 

This can be eaten as part of a mexican salad bowl or in a quasadilla or taco 
Can be eaten by itself in lettuce cups as a low carb high protein option
Pro tip:
increase the amounts for a larger meal prep option, you can also add more veges as you desire and whichever ones you prefer :)
